definition: "The reasoning explicitly sets out an intended course of action, enumerating one or more future steps the agent intends to carry out."

CONSIDERS_COMPETING_HYPOTHESES:

assertion: reasoning presents ≥2 alternative candidate outcomes for the same unknown; explicitly frames the matter as unresolved/needs testing. exclusion: reasoning asserts a single prediction or settled fact; or expresses doubt without naming alternatives.

CHOOSES_DEFAULT_FOR_UNSPECIFIED_REQUIREMENT:

assertion: reasoning states the requirement is unspecified/ambiguous about a concrete behavior; reasoning selects a specific default and justifies it as safe/reasonable/conventional. exclusion: reasoning implements a behavior that the specification states explicitly; or notes the omission without choosing any behavior.

definition: "A targeted action is carried out specifically to obtain evidence about an uncertainty or competing hypothesis raised in reasoning, and the resulting observation reports outcome that bears on it."
assertion: reasoning identifies a concrete uncertainty/competing hypotheses; action is chosen to produce discriminating evidence; observation reports the result that addresses it.

definition: "Reasoning diagnoses the cause of a reported failure of a prior operation and the agent then re-issues the operation with that cause removed."

exclusion: retry without identifying cause; reasoning unrelated to the error; the subsequent action doesn't address error (e.g., abandons task).

exclusion: plan doesn't mention the step; correspondence is only temporal.

candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly sets out an intended course of action, enumerating one or more future steps the agent intends to carry out before producing a result.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that lays out the intended future actions.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly states at least one action the agent intends to perform later.
The intended actions are expressed as a sequence of steps or goals, not as a report of something already done.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only narrates completed actions or observed facts without expressing any future intention.
The reasoning states a vague desire or goal without identifying any intended action.

candidate_predicates.name: CONSIDERS_COMPETING_HYPOTHESES
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning treats an outcome as unresolved and entertains two or more mutually exclusive candidate explanations or behaviors for it, deferring commitment until discriminating evidence is obtained.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text presenting the alternatives about an uncertain outcome.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning presents at least two mutually exclusive candidate outcomes, explanations, or behaviors for the same unknown.
The reasoning explicitly leaves the matter open, indicating that the alternatives must be distinguished by further evidence.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning asserts a single prediction or treats the matter as already settled.
The reasoning expresses generic uncertainty without naming any concrete alternative.

candidate_predicates.name: CHOOSES_DEFAULT_FOR_UNSPECIFIED_REQUIREMENT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning identifies a concrete behavior or value that the task specification leaves unspecified and deliberately adopts a defensible default for it, justifying the choice instead of treating the omission as blocking.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text flagging the unspecified requirement and selecting the default.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that a concrete behavior or value is not specified by the task or specification.
The reasoning selects a specific default behavior or value and gives a reason why that default is safe, conventional, or expected.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning implements a behavior that the specification states explicitly.
The reasoning notes the omission but does not commit to any concrete behavior or value.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_HYPOTHESIS_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted action is performed specifically to obtain evidence about an uncertainty or a set of competing hypotheses raised in reasoning, and the resulting observation reports an outcome that bears on that uncertainty.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performed to produce discriminating evidence about the uncertainty.

parameters.name: hypothesis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that states the uncertainty or competing hypotheses being tested.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result that addresses the tested uncertainty.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a concrete uncertainty or competing candidate behaviors that cannot be settled by reasoning alone.
The action is chosen so that its outcome will discriminate among the candidates or resolve the uncertainty.
The observation reports a concrete outcome that can be interpreted as evidence about the identified uncertainty.
exclusion_conditions: The action serves the main task deliverable rather than the identified uncertainty.
The observation does not address the uncertainty being tested.
No identifiable uncertainty or hypothesis motivates the action.

candidate_predicates.name: CORRECTS_ERROR_WITH_REVISED_ACTION
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning diagnoses the cause of a reported failure of a prior operation, and the agent then re-issues that operation with the diagnosed cause removed.

parameters.name: error_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the prior operation failed or was rejected.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that attributes the failure to a specific cause.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: The revised action that repeats the intended operation with the diagnosed cause addressed.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an error or failed validation of the prior operation.
The reasoning explicitly names the cause of that failure.
The corrective action repeats the intended operation in a form that removes the named cause.
exclusion_conditions: The operation is retried unchanged without any diagnosis of the reported cause.
The reasoning is unrelated to the reported failure.
The subsequent action abandons the operation or addresses an unrelated problem.

candidate_predicates.name: RESOLVES_AMBIGUITY_BY_DEFERRING_TO_OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning identifies an ambiguity or conflict in the specification or expected behavior and resolves it by treating the concrete behavior reported in an observation as authoritative, adapting its subsequent decision accordingly.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that names the ambiguity and adopts the observed behavior as authoritative.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the concrete behavior that settles the ambiguity.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies an ambiguity or conflict between the stated requirement and expected behavior.
The reasoning adopts the concrete outcome reported in the observation as the reference fact and adjusts its decision to match it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning uses the observation as general support without any identified ambiguity.
The observation does not concern the ambiguity in question.
The reasoning continues to speculate about the requirement instead of deferring to the observed behavior.

candidate_predicates.name: EXECUTES_PLANNED_STEP
candidate_predicates.definition: The action carries out one step that was explicitly enumerated in a previously stated plan, matching the content of that intended step rather than merely following it in time.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action that performs one of the enumerated steps.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that enumerates the intended steps.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning enumerates one or more intended steps as a plan.
The action's content corresponds to one of those enumerated steps.
exclusion_conditions: The plan reasoning does not mention any step that matches the action.
The correspondence is only temporal adjacency with no matching intended step.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_EFFECT_OF_PRIOR_ACTION
candidate_predicates.definition: A check action inspects observable state produced by an earlier state-changing action in order to establish whether that change actually took effect, independently of the earlier action's own reported result.

parameters.name: modification_action
parameters.description: The earlier action that changes persistent or runtime state.

parameters.name: verification_action
parameters.description: The later action that inspects state to confirm the effect of the change.

assertion_conditions: The modification action changes state whose effect is independently observable (process status, logs, files, or a listening endpoint).
The verification action reads such state specifically to determine the effect of the modification action.
exclusion_conditions: The verification action inspects state unrelated to the modification action.
The verification action gathers information for an unrelated purpose rather than confirming the modification's effect.
The two actions are merely adjacent in time without an inspection of the modification's effect.
